verdict.rationale: n8n has documented AI agent nodes ('What agents do'), model provider flexibility (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open-source, switchable without architecture change), and built-in MCP client/trigger nodes for tool use, all reflected on the canvas with traceable reasoning steps. Community evidence (n8n-comm-7, n8n-comm-8) corroborates real-world use of AI/LLM-driven workflows with debuggable execution history. Missing for 10: independent hands-on review specifically validating agent step configuration UX and multi-tool orchestration depth beyond docs.
